definitions.explanation: The designated area at an airport where passengers board their aircraft.

examples.japanese: {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}は23{番|ばん}です。
{搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}が{変更|へんこう}になりました。
examples.english: The boarding gate has been changed.

examples.japanese: {出発|しゅっぱつ}30{分前|ぷんまえ}までに{搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}にお{越|こ}しください。
examples.english: Please come to the boarding gate at least 30 minutes before departure.

notes:
An essential airport term for travelers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}{番号|ばんごう} (gate number)
- {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}に{向|む}かう (to head to the boarding gate)
- {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}で{待|ま}つ (to wait at the boarding gate)
- {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}{変更|へんこう} (gate change)

RELATED TERMS:
- {搭乗|とうじょう}: boarding
- {搭乗券|とうじょうけん}: boarding pass
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}ロビー: departure lobby
- ゲート: gate (loanword)
